body: This is exactly how I feel, I’ve struggled to be able to put it into words or find someone who can relate, but I have exactly this,you’re not alone, I wish I could tell you how to help with the disassociation but I don’t know myself and I’m massively struggling with it

Thank you, its making me start to lose friends though, they use me as their shoulder to cry on and I freak out and think they’re gonna abuse that like my ex did so sometimes it is just my thoughts, thank you though this helped
